result.summary: Adds explicit return type annotations to Python test framework helpers add_p2p_connection and add_outbound_p2p_connection. This ensures language servers and type checkers infer the return value as P2PInterface rather than Any.
result.problem: Python language servers treat the return value of add_p2p_connection helpers as Any because the return types are not annotated, degrading developer experience and editor autocompletion.
evidence: Author description: "Return type of add_p2p_connection and add_outbound_p2p_connection is not explicitly typed so LSPs treats the return as Any. Add explicit return type to improve DX."
result.scope_notes: Small annotation change in the Python functional test framework.
result.card: Adds explicit return type annotations to Python test framework helpers add_p2p_connection and add_outbound_p2p_connection so language server protocols and type checkers recognize the return type as P2PInterface instead of Any. This addresses developer tooling and autocompletion friction for contributors writing functional tests. No external dependencies or issues are linked.

risk.why: It only touches type annotations in test framework helpers, which cannot affect node runtime behavior or cause test regressions.
